title: Console preview panel — iframe (web) / log view (process) + controls + sample fixtures
description: BETA-TEST GOAL (goal-app-preview), part 4 of 5 — the HUMAN-OBSERVABLE PAYOFF. A Preview tab/panel in the unified console shell: Start/Stop/Restart controls, a status indicator, an iframe pointing at the running app URL (web mode) or a live log console (process mode), live-updating via the 067 stream/poll, XSS-safe. Also lands the SAMPLE FIXTURES used for UAT: a minimal static web page app and a minimal canvas/Phaser game page (OFFLINE — vendored or plain-canvas, no network dependency), each with a start command + a preview config so they are previewable. Depends on 067.
acceptance_criteria: A Preview panel/tab in the console (extends the v0.5.0 unified shell) with Start/Stop/Restart controls + a state/status indicator.

Web mode -> an iframe whose src is the running app URL from /api/preview/status; process mode -> a live log view; the panel switches by status.mode. XSS-safe (createElement/textContent; iframe src set only to the resolved localhost URL).
Live update via the existing stream/poll so state + logs + the iframe appearing/disappearing reflect start/stop WITHOUT a page reload.
Graceful when mode=none (no preview config) -> a hint card (configure preview in PROJECT.md), no crash; graceful when the previewed process exits.
Sample fixtures added under tests/fixtures: a minimal web-page app AND a minimal canvas/Phaser game app, OFFLINE (no network), each runnable via a start command, used by the UAT.
tests-after: implement, prove by running, then minimal regression locks (panel render presence + controls wired + mode-switch + graceful-absent); e2e under tests/e2e/; rebuild dist.

UAT (human-observable payoff): launch console -> Preview tab -> start the web fixture (see it render live in the iframe) -> start the canvas/phaser fixture (see/play it) -> start a process-only target (see logs) -> stop (preview tears down). npm run test:all green.

comments.author: uat
comments.body:
UAT — console preview panel (verdicts: all PASS, verified by Orchestrator at the human's request; the human launched the console, could see both Orchestrator|Preview tabs, then delegated the functional verification to the Orchestrator, who drove the live board server's real HTTP routes + the offline fixtures end-to-end). Steps:
1) (AC1) Preview tab + Start/Stop/Restart controls + status indicator present — Expected: panel + controls render. Observed: served HTML has tab-preview button + preview-start/stop/restart-btn + status chip. PASS (verified by Orchestrator at the human's request).
2) (AC4) No preview config -> hint, no crash — Expected: hint card, no crash. Observed: POST /api/preview/start -> HTTP 409 {error:'no preview configured', hint:'Add preview_command...'} and the server survives (subsequent status 200, state=stopped, source=none). PASS (verified by Orchestrator at the human's request).
3) (AC2 web) Web fixture -> iframe — Expected: running web app in iframe. Observed: PROJECT.md preview_command=node tests/fixtures/preview-web/server.js, preview_mode=web -> start -> status running, mode=web, source=configured, url=http://localhost:54647; fetching that url returns the fixture page ('Web Fixture' / 'Hello from the web fixture') = what the iframe loads. PASS (verified by Orchestrator at the human's request).
4) (AC2 game) Canvas/Phaser fixture -> iframe — Expected: game renders/plays. Observed: preview_command=node tests/fixtures/preview-canvas/server.js -> running, url detected; served page contains <canvas> + getContext + requestAnimationFrame (the bouncing-ball animation). PASS (verified by Orchestrator at the human's request).
5) (AC2/AC3 process) Process-only target -> live log view — Expected: streaming logs, no iframe. Observed: preview_mode=process -> status mode=process, recentLogs=['Listening on http://localhost:50752']; SSE /api/preview/stream emitted {type:'status'} on connect + {type:'log',line:'Listening on http://localhost:60540'} live (no route call). PASS (verified by Orchestrator at the human's request).
6) (AC3) Stop -> teardown — Expected: preview tears down, no reload. Observed: POST /api/preview/stop -> {ok:true,state:'stopped'}, status state=stopped, url=null. PASS (verified by Orchestrator at the human's request).
Guard parity spot-check: wrong Content-Type -> 415, bad Host -> 403. AC5 fixtures confirmed OFFLINE (no network) and runnable. AC6/AC7 automated gate: npm run test:all 922 passed/5 skipped. PROJECT.md temporarily edited for the live drive then reverted (git diff clean). OVERALL: PASS — every AC covered, all steps PASS.

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body: CLOSED done via the goal-app-preview loop drive (iteration 4). tests-after + mandatory UAT (human-observable payoff). IMPL 55107f7: Preview tab in the v0.5.0 unified shell (Start/Stop/Restart + status chip), iframe for web mode / live log view for process mode / hint card for none, live SSE-driven updates, XSS-safe (createElement+textContent; iframe.src only set to a validated localhost URL); + OFFLINE sample fixtures (tests/fixtures/preview-web minimal http page, tests/fixtures/preview-canvas vanilla-canvas requestAnimationFrame animation); + 14 regression locks; dist/task-board.cjs rebuilt. Fresh-context review APPROVE-WITH-FOLLOWUPS (0 HIGH): the XSS-critical iframe-src path proven safe against a full attack matrix; 1 MEDIUM = validateLocalhostUrl had no regression lock. IN-BAND 4057f9e: extracted validateLocalhostUrl as a single-source exported fn injected into the client via toString (no drift) + 26-case unit matrix + 3 injection-assertion locks. That tightening over-corrected (rejected configured preview_url with a path) -> IN-BAND 602b75d: relaxed to origin-based new URL() validation (accept any path/query/hash on a localhost http origin; reject every non-localhost/non-http/userinfo attack), +4 path-bearing accept cases. Reviewer cold-verified both: APPROVE (XSS guard intact, path regression resolved). UAT: all 6 steps PASS, verified by Orchestrator at the human's request (human saw the tabs, delegated functional verification; Orchestrator drove the live routes + fixtures: web iframe page, canvas animation, process logs, 409+hint, stop teardown, 415/413/403 parity). Release-tier gate green: npm run test:all 922 passed/5 skipped, dist-parity holds. Commits LOCAL on beta, NOT pushed (auto_push gate ON).
